content.short: QTon is a quest-based onboarding app on TON that rewards users for discovering new decentralized projects.
content.description: QTon is a dedicated quest-based application on the TON blockchain designed to simplify the user onboarding process for new decentralized projects. It functions as an interactive gateway where users can complete specific tasks and learning 'quests' to discover and interact with various dApps and tokens. By rewarding participants for their engagement, QTon helps projects build a verified and active user base from day one while providing users with a fun and educational way to earn tokens and explore the diverse services within the TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Discover TON dApps and earn rewards with QTon. The premier onboarding quest app on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
